{{Quote|On broken feet I walk, crushed and alone. / The lies they told me have turned the world gray.<br />But oh, that you still breathe and live / Is a song in this void, that gives me life again.|Part of "Kalas and Fiana"|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''"Kalas and Fiana"''' was a romance written by the [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was a favorite of [[Nadia Grell]].
